sql: SELECT T2."Character Name" FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID WHERE T1.Title='Batman' ORDER BY T2.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.Title FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T3.Name='Tom Cruise'
SELECT T2."Character Name" FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T3.Name='Tom Cruise' AND T1.Title='Born on the Fourth of July'
SELECT AVG(T1.Rating) FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T3.Name='Tom Cruise'

SELECT (MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.screentime,3,2) AS REAL)) - MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.screentime,3,2) AS REAL))) * 100 / MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(T2.screentime,3,2) AS REAL)) FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID WHERE T1.Title='Batman'
SELECT T2."Character Name" FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID WHERE T2.creditOrder=1 AND T1.Genre='Thriller' ORDER BY T1.Rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T3.Name FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title='Batman' ORDER BY T2.screentime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T3."Birth City" FROM characters T2 JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T2."Character Name"='Gabriel Martin'
SELECT T3.Name FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title='American Hustle' AND T2.creditOrder=2
SELECT T3.Name FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1."Release Date"='2015-10-26' AND T2.creditOrder=1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3."Birth Country"='USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T3.ActorID) FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title='Mrs. Doubtfire'
SELECT Name FROM actor WHERE ActorID=439 AND Gender='Male' AND Ethnicity='White'

SELECT T3.NetWorth, T3."Date of Birth" FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title='Die Hard 2' AND T3."Height (Inches)" BETWEEN 60 AND 65

SELECT T1.Gross FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Genre='Comedy' AND T1.Rating<7 AND CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(T3.NetWorth,',',''),'$','') AS REAL)>375000000

SELECT T2."Character Name" FROM movie T1 JOIN characters T2 ON T1.MovieID=T2.MovieID JOIN actor T3 ON T3.ActorID=T2.ActorID WHERE T1.Title='Bruce Almighty' AND T3."Birth City"='Sherman Oaks' AND T3.Gender='Female' AND T3."Height (Inches)" > (SELECT AVG("Height (Inches)")*0.5 FROM actor)
